target: parsec multi-agent bundle (orchestrator.md + 6 domain agents + shared_context.md; capabilities: [system-prompt]) -- the ORIGINAL, unmodified skill, zero-shot, 5 trials/task, no optimization step

noise_floor.note: A per-task improvement smaller than min_detectable_per_task_delta cannot be distinguished from run-to-run noise at 5 trials, so a hill-climb gate that accepts on any per-task gain will accept noise. The suite mean is far better resolved (se_of_suite_mean), so pooled movement of ~3x that is meaningful. Gate on suite movement, or raise trials for the gate.

provenance.source_generator: parsec-intake_v5 worktree, scripts/parsec/v5/collect.py (gitignored there -- vendored here as a frozen snapshot)
provenance.skill_under_test: artifacts/v5/seed/ -- verified byte-identical (8/8 files) to parsec commit 28e2c40's config/prompts/ via a fresh clone of the parsec reference repo, and byte-identical to this branch's own artifacts/v4/seed/. This is the real original skill.
provenance.discarded_predecessor: An earlier run of this same sweep (v5_t1_e1, 68 tasks) was discarded: its skill was byte-identical (8/8 prompt files) to artifacts/v4/v4_g_e1/rejected/cand_0001 -- a candidate produced by v4's GLOBAL optimizer arm, left installed in the live parsec clone's working tree (parsec git HEAD still read 28e2c40) and inherited when the v5 benchmark tree was built from that clone. It was never a baseline. On the 68 tasks shared with this arm it inflated the mean by +0.151 (0.7372 -> 0.8885).
provenance.no_optimizer_stage: v5_b1_e1 is a zero-shot sweep -- there is no seed/candidate/best/final lineage here, unlike v4_t_e1 and v4_g_e1.
